items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a finite morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces is quasi-finite (source lines 9467-9470). The proof uses the two locality statements to reduce both properties to the case of an affine base Y, observes that a finite morphism over an affine base makes X a scheme, and then invokes the corresponding result for schemes.
